book.title: MAK Mak Ne Jisas Klays Takaw Teplep Ak Kɨl Tɨkak

content: Tap yɨŋ yɨmeb agɨl takaw paladaŋ lɨl agak

Jisas ne Galili cheb gol ak amɨl, binɨb okok kɨlop tepayaŋ takaw agñɨnɨg gaknɨŋ, binɨb kuŋay yɨbɨl apnan gɨlak. Anɨgelak, Jisas bot adek ak besɨgɨl, am ñɨg nab sɨŋak mɨdɨlɨg, kɨli ñɨg gol sɨŋak yelak okok kɨlop takaw agñak.
Takaw anɨb okok paladaŋ lɨl, adek keke yɨbɨl agñak.
Adek olap paladaŋ lɨl agak, Takaw agɨnɨgebin ak nɨgɨm agak. Bɨ olap wit jakaŋ agɨl, wit mɨdup ak nab wog day okok yokɨnɨgab agak.
Yokenɨgab, ogɨnap kanɨb nab ak yapenɨgab, yawl okok pen ap nɨŋɨd mɨdupsek ñɨŋɨnɨgabal agak.
Ogɨnap kab adek lum sɨkol sɨkol lɨnɨgab okok yapɨl kasek jakɨnɨgab ak pen,
kɨdɨl palawl ma amnak tek, sub nɨŋɨd mɨlep gɨnɨgab agak.
Ogɨnap kɨkasɨk tap ñuñu adek yenɨgab nab okok yapɨl jakɨnɨgab ak pen, kɨkasɨk tap ñuñu okok pak ñɨbek mɨdup ma pulɨnɨgab agak.
Pen ogɨnap lum tep adek ak yapɨl, jak tep gɨl, mɨdup pɨl tep yɨbɨl gɨnɨgab agak. Ogɨnap mɨdup 30 tek pulɨnɨgab, ogɨnap mɨdup 60 tek pulɨnɨgab, ogɨnap 100 tek pulɨnɨgab agak.
Jisas takaw anɨb ak agjulɨg agak, Nɨbi binɨb tɨmud sek okok, takaw anɨb ak nɨgɨnɨmɨb agak.
Takaw paladaŋ lɨl apan jɨj ak tay agɨlak
Binɨb Jisas takaw agaknɨŋ, ap nɨg yelak anɨb okok, keke amnɨlak. Amnɨlaknɨŋ, bɨne anep umɨgan ak sek, binɨb ogɨnap sek nop agɨlak, Takaw paladaŋ lɨl apan jɨj ak tay agɨlak?

Agelak agak, God binɨb dɨl kɨlop kod yenɨgab ak, takaw we gɨl mɨdolɨgup ak nɨbop gos ñek nɨgɨnɨgabɨm agak. Binɨb yokɨp okok pen, kɨli takaw paladaŋ lɨl agak ak nɨgɨnɨgabal ak pen, takaw jɨj ak ma nɨgɨnɨgabal agak.
Anɨb ak tek,

content.text: Wɨdɨn pel nepal ak pen, tap ogɨnap ma nepal agak. Takaw pel nepal ak pen, takaw jɨj agup anɨb agɨl ma nepal agak. Nɨgtep gɨpɨlap tek, God nop agnɨgebɨlap, tap si tap tɨmel gɨpal ak tɨg walɨg gɨyokɨpɨkop agak.

content: Paladaŋ lɨl takaw jɨj ak agñak
Jisas anɨb agɨl kɨlop agak, Takaw paladaŋ lɨl agen ma nepɨm anɨb ak, taydɨl kɨdek takaw paladaŋ lɨl agenɨgayn nɨgɨnɨgabɨm agak?
Bɨ anɨb ak tap yɨŋ yɨmnɨgab ak, God takaw ne ak yɨmnɨgab agak.
Mɨdup ogɨnap kanɨb adek ak yapek, yawl okok ap ñɨŋɨnɨgabal apin ak, binɨb okok God takaw nepal ak pen, won ak Satan ap gek, sawl gɨnɨgabal agɨl apin agak.

Pen ogɨnap kab adek lum sɨkol sɨkol lɨnɨgab okok yapɨl jakɨnɨgab ak pen, kɨdɨl am wos ma gek, sub nɨŋɨd mɨlep gɨnɨgab apin ak, binɨb okok God takaw ak kɨdek won ak nɨgel tep gaknɨŋ dɨnɨgabal apin agak. Tep gaknɨŋ dɨnɨgabal ak pen, yokɨp sɨkol won olap mɨdɨl, binɨb ogɨnap takaw agel nɨŋɨd akaŋ, mɨŋel ogɨnap apek, takaw nop ak kelɨgɨnɨgabal agɨl apin agak.
Pen kɨkasɨk tap ñuñu nab ak yapɨl jakɨl mɨdup ma pulɨnɨgab apin ak, binɨb okok God takaw ne nɨgɨnɨgabal ak pen,
wog wali, kal mɨj kɨneb, tu mɨnan, mani, tap okok gos kuŋay nɨŋɨd, kuŋay dun agɨl gos nɨgɨnɨgabal agɨl apin agak. Nɨgenɨgabal, God takaw ne ak pak ñɨbek tap mɨdup ne ma pulɨnɨgab agɨl apin agak.

Pen wit mɨdup lum tep adek ak yapɨl jak tep gɨl, mɨdup 30 tek pulɨnɨgab akaŋ, mɨdup 60 tek pulɨnɨgab akaŋ, mɨdup 100 tek pulɨnɨgab apin ak, binɨb okok God takaw nɨŋɨd nop pɨsnep chɨgɨnɨgabal okok apin agak. Kɨli takaw ne dɨtep gɨl, mɨdup ne pulɨnɨgab apin agak.
Bɨ sup agɨlɨl ma we gɨlak
Jisas pen tepayaŋ takaw olap paladaŋ lɨl agak, Sup ak dagɨl, abañ muk okok akaŋ, tin muk okok ma lɨpal agak. Mɨlek gɨnɨmuŋ agɨl, adek sɨŋak tɨk lɨpal agak.
Anɨb ak tek, tap okok mɨdupsek we gɨl mɨdeb, sayn mɨseŋ lɨnɨgab agak. Bɨ tap okok mɨdupsek we gel mɨdeb, sayn mɨseŋ lek, binɨb nɨgɨnɨgabal agak.
Nɨbi binɨb gos tɨmud sek yenɨmɨb okok, takaw agebin awl nɨgtep gɨnɨmɨb agak.
Pen kɨlop takaw olap agak, Takaw nɨgebɨm ak nɨŋɨd, nɨgtep gɨnɨmɨb agak. Takaw anɨb ak nɨgenɨgabɨm ak, nɨgtep gɨnɨgabɨm agak. Pen God nɨbop gos teplep yɨbɨl ñenɨgab, nɨgtep gɨnɨgabɨm agak.
Binɨb takaw nɨŋɨd nɨg dɨnɨgabal okok, takaw tep ogɨnap sek nɨgɨnɨgabal agak. Pen binɨb takaw nɨŋɨd ma nɨg dɨnɨgabal okok, kɨli sɨkol sɨkol nepal ak sek pɨsnep kul gɨnɨgab agak.
Tap mɨdup jakak agɨl takaw paladaŋ lɨl agak
Jisas takaw olap pen agak, God binɨb dɨl kɨlop kod yenɨgab ak, bɨ wog nap ak wit mɨdup jakaŋ agɨl, dam wog day ne okok yokek jakɨnɨgab tek nep gɨnɨgab agak.
Wit mɨdup wog day okok yokɨl, maynab kɨnenɨgab, subnab ajenɨgab nɨŋɨd, gup gɨl jakɨnɨgab ak pen, taydɨl jakup agɨl ma nɨgɨnɨgab agak.
Lum ne ke gek jakɨl, mɨdup pulɨnɨgab agak. Ned gup jakɨl, nonɨm gup kɨdek mɨdup pulɨnɨgab agak.
Pen tap mɨdup ne ñɨŋeb ñɨn ak jakek, bɨ anɨb ak ne mɨdup ñɨŋeb tek mɨdeb ak tɨkɨnɨgab agak.
Mab mastet mɨdup jakak agɨl takaw paladaŋ lɨl agak
Jisas anɨb agɨl agak, God binɨb dɨl kɨlop kod yenɨgab ak, tay takaw paladaŋ lɨl agɨnɨgayn nɨbi nɨgɨnɨgabɨm agak?
Nɨm, mab mastet yɨŋ tek ak agɨnɨm agak. Tap yɨŋ ogɨnap awl yɨbal okok jakup, pen mastet yɨŋ ak sɨkol yɨbɨl yɨbal agak.
Yɨmel, jak awl gɨl, wog nab jakup ak pen, ne tap awl yɨbɨl jakup agak. Jakɨl, lek pakek, yawl okok ap mab lek adek okok lɨ mɨdɨl, sɨsi okok we gɨpal agak.
Jisas takaw paladaŋ lɨl nep agak
Jisas binɨb okok kɨlop takaw paladaŋ lɨl anɨb okok tek kuŋay yɨbɨl agñolɨgup, gos kɨli nɨgɨnɨgel won ak tek agolɨgup.
Takaw mɨseŋ agñen ma nɨgɨnɨgabal agɨl, paladaŋ lɨl nep agñolɨgup ak pen, bɨne okok ayɨp ke mɨdɨlɨg ñɨn ak, takaw jɨj okok agñɨtep golɨgup.
Jisas gek yɨgen awl dek ak kelɨgak
Ñɨn anɨb anep dugep won ak, Jisas bɨne okok kɨlop agak, Kɨd adaŋ amnun agak.
Anɨb agɨl, bɨne okok ayɨp binɨb kuŋay yɨbɨl ap yelak okok kɨlop kelɨgɨl, bot Jisas yek mɨgan ak amɨl, kɨli saŋɨdɨlak. Pen bot ogɨnap abe yelak.
Nab amnɨlaknɨŋ, day yɨgen awl tɨmel yɨbɨl apɨl, ñɨg cheb awl ak pagɨl bot mɨgan ak amnak.
Jisas ne pen bot mɨgan day ayɨm yɨl, kɨmɨg mab lɨl kɨnek, bɨne okok nop am kaskas gɨl agɨlak, Tisa, chɨn mɨdupsek kumnɨgobun gos ak ma nepan agɨlak?
Agelak, Jisas tɨkjakɨl, yɨgen awl dek ak sek, ñɨg cheb awl ak pag apek ak sek takaw kɨles gɨl agak, Tep, kelɨgan agak. Agek kelɨgak.
Pen bɨne okok kɨlop agak, Taynen pɨlɨkɨpɨm agak? God nop gos ma lɨnepɨm akaŋ agak?
Agek, kɨli pɨlɨkɨl, pen kɨli ke agnɨg agnɨg agɨlak, Bɨ anɨb awl an agɨlak? Taydɨl agosup yɨgen awl dek ak sek, ñɨg pag apek ak sek agup tek kelɨgup agɨlak.
